memos.argument: A cycle computer displaying speed, distance and time is principally a speedometer/odometer. Heading 9029 names speedometers and odometers, and subheading 9029.20.20 is expressly 'Bicycle speedometers'. A multi-function cycle computer with sensor is a bicycle speedometer whose clock/trip features are secondary (GRI 1, 3(b)).
exclusions_against: Ch90 Note 1 excludes certain items, but nothing there targets speedometers; heading 9029 is 'other than those of 9014 or 9015'
Clock and trip functions could be argued as composite instruments (Ch90 note on composite machines/9031)
No cross_search ruling directly on cycle computers retrieved

memos.argument: The unit is mounted on the bicycle handlebar as an accessory; heading 8714 covers parts and accessories of cycles, and rulings classify handlebar accessories like horns there (G84554 classified a bicycle horn in 8714.99.8000).
exclusions_against: Section XVII Note 2(f)/Ch90 precedence: Ch87 parts exclude Ch90 instruments (Section XVII note excludes articles of chapter 90); speedometers are specifically named in 9029 and HTS 9029.20.20 names bicycle speedometers
Accessory heading is residual vs specific instrument heading; G84554 concerns a horn, not an instrument

memos.argument: The device includes a clock/time display and electronically displays time with an opto-electronic display; stop-watch style functions fit 9102 'other watches, including stop watches'. Ruling G88557 treated a quartz digital wrist watch in 9102.12.80.
exclusions_against: 9102 covers watches (worn on the person, pocket); a handlebar unit is not a watch
Ch91 Note 3 watch movements concept requires a timekeeping device; time is secondary to speed/distance
Ruling G88557 concerns a wrist watch, not a mounted cycle computer

memos.argument: As a multi-function electronic measuring device with a sensor, 9031 residual 'measuring or checking instruments not specified elsewhere in this chapter' could apply if speedometer heading did not cover the multi-function measurement of distance and time.
exclusions_against: 9031 by its terms applies only if not specified in another heading of Ch90; 9029 specifically names speedometers/odometers
F89299 concerns photogrammetry equipment, only weak analogy
